name: Privacy Mark Assistant Auditor

third_party_evaluations.summary: JIPDEC-registered auditor for Japan's Privacy Mark (JIS Q 15001) scheme.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 2, specialty: 1. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded JIPDEC registration, JIS Q 15001 alignment and three-year profile support professional privacy-assurance work in Japan; local scheme recognition does not imply broader international privacy expertise.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The recorded registered-auditor role in the JIS Q 15001 scheme and three-year profile support professional privacy-audit knowledge. Its local recognition and unspecified practical assessment limit its direct value outside Japanese privacy engagements.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded JIS Q 15001 Privacy Mark auditor role is tied to a specific Japanese privacy scheme. Specialty captures that jurisdiction-specific advisory branch without treating limited EU transferability as a claim of low competence.
